order.service_description: Magnetic resonance imaging of the lumbar spine, without contrast

records.summary: Plain X-ray of the lumbar spine. Mild narrowing of the disc space at L4-L5. No fracture.
Low back pain that spreads to the left leg for 3 weeks. Straight leg raise is positive on the left at 40 degrees. No bowel or bladder symptoms.
Naproxen 500 mg twice a day for 4 weeks, then stopped. The patient reports partial relief only.
Physical therapy: 6 sessions over 3 weeks. Pain 7 of 10 at the start and 6 of 10 at the end. Little change.
Pain in the left leg continues at 7 weeks. New numbness in the left foot. Weakness of ankle dorsiflexion, 4 of 5.
